title: Official CAD Assistant ARM64 package integrity preflight
scope: Preflight the previously selected official macOS ARM64 ACIS reader without launching it, and determine whether this host can safely produce independent P7 semantics evidence.

findings: Official page lists CAD Assistant 1.6.0, dated 2021-10-05, and an Apple silicon ARM64 DMG.
The page says ACIS SAT/SAB import is provided by commercial OCCT XDE components and export/conversion is disabled for those imported formats.
The page says selected parts expose geometric properties including area, volume and centroid; no machine-readable batch interface is documented.

download.hdiutilVerify: PASS; all disk-image CRC checks verified
download.sevenZipTest: PASS; all 438 files and 94 directories passed archive checks

extractedCandidate.codesignBundle: FAIL: invalid signature (code or signature have been modified)
extractedCandidate.codesignExecutable: FAIL: invalid signature (code or signature have been modified)

hostLimitations: hdiutil verify works, but hdiutil attach returns Device not configured.
diskutil image attach/imageinfo cannot access the DiskManagement framework in this environment.

Because the disk image could not be mounted natively, the 7-Zip extraction may have altered HFS metadata or links; the extracted signature failure cannot be attributed conclusively to the published DMG contents.
The app was not launched, and no SAT/SAB semantic observation was made.
disposition: Native mounted app integrity is verified. Repeat with observable import and exact geometry measurements; no ACIS semantic or support claim follows from the launch.
fixturePolicy: No DWG/DXF fixtures or application files were added to the repository; the package and extracted files remain under /private/tmp.

nativeRecheck20261103.launch: The native mounted app was launched via macOS open with a locally authored SAB. Its window title showed the input filename, but its visible screen showed the file browser. Import and geometry measurements remain unconfirmed. The app was closed and the image unmounted.
